definitions.explanation: The central office or location from which a military operation, organization, or large-scale effort is directed and controlled. Most commonly used in military contexts.

examples.japanese: {司令部|しれいぶ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。

examples.english: The command center was set up in the mountains.

examples.japanese: {連合軍|れんごうぐん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{司令部|しれいぶ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{占領|せんりょう}→占領：11863_senryou⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指揮|しき}した→指揮する：21994_shikisuru⟧。
examples.english: The Allied forces' headquarters was established in Tokyo and directed the occupation policies.

notes:
{司令部|しれいぶ} is primarily a military term. GHQ ({連合国軍|れんごうこくぐん}⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧⟦{司令官|しれいかん}→司令官：20907_shireikan⟧{総|そう}{司令部|しれいぶ}) is a well-known historical example from the postwar occupation of Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {司令部|しれいぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧ — to establish a command center
- {司令部|しれいぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧ — to report to headquarters
- {総|そう}{司令部|しれいぶ} — general headquarters (GHQ)
- ⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧{司令部|しれいぶ} — operations command

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{司令官|しれいかん}→司令官：20907_shireikan⟧ — commander
- ⟦{本部|ほんぶ}→本部：00112_honbu⟧ — headquarters (general/non-military)
- ⟦{指揮|しき}→指揮：11102_shiki⟧ — command, direction
